params.1273: Play some rounds of Werewolf Skullball.
params.1274: Make sure you have a Ring of Charos equipped and talk to the werewolf in the small shack south-east of Canifis.
params.1275: Enter the trap door, climb down the ladder and talk to Skullball Boss.
